title: Our Institutional Capabilities
description: Explore our comprehensive capability decks showcasing how IP3 partners with institutions to deliver transformative outcomes at scale.

cards.title: Public Financial Management Deck
cards.overview: Our PFM practice combines diagnostic rigor with hands-on implementation support, having delivered reforms across 35 countries.
cards.description: Comprehensive capability overview for PFM reform, budget transparency, and fiscal governance programs.

cards.title: Sovereign Debt Advisory Deck
cards.overview: We provide strategic advisory on debt portfolio management, liability management operations, and creditor negotiations.
cards.description: End-to-end sovereign debt management, restructuring advisory, and debt sustainability analysis capabilities.

cards.title: Judicial Reform Deck
cards.overview: We partner with judiciaries and ministries of justice to modernize case management, improve access, and strengthen independence.
cards.description: Institutional strengthening for justice systems including case management, access to justice, and judicial training.

cards.title: Renewable Energy Transition Deck
cards.overview: We support governments and utilities through the full energy transition lifecycle from policy design to project implementation.
cards.description: Policy advisory, investment mobilization, and regulatory framework design for clean energy transitions.

cards.title: Universal Health Coverage Deck
cards.overview: Our UHC practice integrates financing, service delivery, and governance to expand equitable access to quality healthcare.
cards.description: Health financing, system strengthening, and UHC roadmap development for low and middle-income countries.

cards.title: Digital Public Infrastructure Deck
cards.overview: We help governments design and deploy interoperable digital ID, payments, and data exchange systems at national scale.
cards.description: DPI strategy, implementation support, and governance frameworks for national digital transformation.

cards.title: Anti-Corruption & Integrity Deck
cards.overview: We design and implement comprehensive integrity systems that reduce corruption risks and rebuild public trust.
cards.description: Institutional integrity frameworks, procurement reform, and transparency system design.

cards.title: Climate Finance Mobilization Deck
cards.overview: We structure innovative finance mechanisms that mobilize private capital for climate adaptation and mitigation projects.
cards.description: Blended finance structuring, green bond advisory, and climate investment pipeline development.

cards.title: Education System Reform Deck
cards.overview: We partner with education ministries to transform systems for equity, quality, and relevance in rapidly changing economies.
cards.description: Curriculum modernization, teacher development, and education financing for 21st-century learning.
